Mira is pressing a SEVENTH flattened pattern onto the page with the heel of her hand, and this one is unmistakably the SHORT FAT BLUNT-NOSED fold from the previous scene. Tomas leans on the bench beside her watching, chin near his hands. Warm daylight from the window. The pages carry ONLY crease patterns and paste marks: NO words, NO titles, NO labels, NO numbers, NO readable handwriting anywhere. THERE IS NO ROBOT, NO MECHANICAL FIGURE, NO TOY ROBOT, NO AUTOMATON and NO MACHINE WITH A FACE anywhere in this image. Only the people named above are present. She is NOT standing behind the bench facing the camera across it: there is no floor on that side.
